summary: Previous and Next keys around the page numbers, folding to "Page 3 of 10" on a phone.

props.name: page
props.description: The current page, counting from 1. Controlled; pair with `onPageChange`.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description: The page it starts on when uncontrolled.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the new page whenever it changes.

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one before a gap.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: What the button before the pages says.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: What the button after the pages says.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: What the landmark is called for screen readers.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the buttons. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: animated
props.description: Slides the current page's key to the next. Turn it off for one that jumps, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
